description: Find Meteostat weather stations near a latitude/longitude coordinate, sorted by distance. Returns station IDs to use with station_info and the daily/monthly/hourly observation tools. Data: Meteostat open station directory (CC BY 4.0), no auth required.

lat.description: Latitude of the search point (WGS84 decimal degrees).

limit.description: Maximum number of stations to return, nearest first (default 10, max 50).

lon.description: Longitude of the search point (WGS84 decimal degrees).

name: meteostat.stations.nearby

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Find Nearby Weather Stations
